note: XVIII council: medium exterior through the study window (Ian, 18 Nov).
style: A cinematic Romantic oil painting of 1893 in exactly the manner, palette and light of the reference painting: cool blue moonlit night outside, warm amber lamplight inside, rich painterly brushwork. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Medium exterior view at night, closer to the house than the reference: the tall lit study window of the asylum fills most of the picture, its stone frame and ivy wet with dew, moonlight on the glass. Through the panes, six people sit round a lamplit table covered with papers: an elderly professor with grey hair and round dark spectacles standing at the head of the table, a dark-haired young woman, and four young men listening; faces small and painterly, in warm light. Dark leaves and garden in the foreground.
